page0.text:
I don't hesitate.
I stare into Saber's eyes, and answer her gaze by bringing my heavy arms down.

page1.text:
She doesn't resist.
I end her life with a precise strike.

page2.text:
"—, —"
I had memories with her.
Even now, I felt the warmth of life from her.
Her warmth was always right next to me, and I can never forget it.

page3.text:
I kill her, along with those memories.
I gouge out my memories and throw them into a place I can't reach.
They'll never come back.
I'll never remember her again.
I'll never be forgiven for this.

page4.text:
I chose this path.
I killed others to save Sakura.
I killed a girl close to me, who protected me until the very end, with my own hands.
I'm not allowed to regret or repent.
...This is what it means to choose to be someone's ally.
To protect my ego, to protect the one I love, I'm going to keep robbing others of their precious things.

page5.text:
Beyond that...
I'll never find anything brilliant enough to make up for what was lost.

page6.text:
"But Saber..."
For the rest of my life, I'll keep searching for happiness that can make up for what was lost.
I can already see that my debts will keep piling up until one day, I can no longer move.
Yet... pathetic, absurd, and worthless though it may be, I'll take responsibility for what I stole.

page7.text:
I don't know where to find happiness.
Still, I swear never to give up, even if there's no end to my quest.

page8.text: "...Thank you. You saved me so many times."

page9.text:
...My dagger stops meeting resistance.
The black swordsman silently stares up at me as she sinks into the black shadow.
